{{Top|leg}}
'''Chir'daki One''' was the callsign that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tal'dira]] utilized for his ''[[Chir'daki]]'' during the [[Bacta War]]. During that conflict, he led a full [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of these craft in support of the ex-[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogues]] flying with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] against former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]'s forces occupying the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
